description: On the bed in front of you there’s a light blue bowl, a small green “F” block, a white splat-shaped piece, a green leaf-shaped piece, a yellow lemon-shaped toy, and a small white rubber duck. The left hand reaches forward toward the yellow lemon-shaped toy, grasps it as a left-hand object, lifts it, moves it leftward over the bowl, then lowers and releases it into the bowl while the right hand stays nearby on the right without touching anything.
